objective: Generic multi-tenant online ordering API. Per-account storefront endpoints (public menu + order intake), merchant portal endpoints (menu/item/pricing CRUD, order listing, settings), admin portal endpoints (account list, activate/deactivate, summary, reps). Auth via signed tokens with merchant/admin roles. A pluggable 'provider' interface for order notifications (email/sms/printer stubs) and a pluggable settlement/payout interface to be implemented later.
notes: Reference implementation exists at /root/.openclaw/workspace/orderport (hand-written). Factory should produce the generic API scaffolding; payment provider + settlement details are filled in later by the requester.
